Root.description:
Represents the checkbox itself.
Renders a `<span>` element and a hidden `<input>` beside.

props.name: name
props.description: Identifies the field when a form is submitted.

props.name: defaultChecked
props.description: Whether the checkbox is initially ticked. To render a controlled checkbox, use the `checked` prop instead.

props.name: checked
props.description: Whether the checkbox is currently ticked. To render an uncontrolled checkbox, use the `defaultChecked` prop instead.

props.name: onCheckedChange
props.description: Event handler called when the checkbox is ticked or unticked.

props.name: indeterminate
props.description: Whether the checkbox is in a mixed state: neither ticked, nor unticked.

props.name: value
props.description:
The checkbox's value. Identifies it within a [Checkbox Group](https://base-ui.com/react/components/checkbox-group), falling back to `name` when omitted.
When submitting a form, a checked box submits `value`; with no `value`, it submits the native "on".

props.name: form
props.description:
Identifies the form that owns the hidden input.
Useful when the checkbox is rendered outside the form.

props.name: nativeButton
props.description:
Whether the component renders a native `<button>` element when replacing it
via the `render` prop.
Set to `true` if the rendered element is a native button.

props.name: parent
props.description: Whether the checkbox controls a group of child checkboxes. Must be used in a [Checkbox Group](https://base-ui.com/react/components/checkbox-group).

props.name: uncheckedValue
props.description:
The value submitted with the form when the checkbox is unchecked.
By default, unchecked checkboxes do not submit any value, matching native checkbox behavior.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the component should ignore user interaction.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Whether the user should be unable to tick or untick the checkbox.

props.name: required
props.description: Whether the user must tick the checkbox before submitting a form.

props.name: inputRef
props.description: A ref to access the hidden `<input>` element.

props.name: id
props.description: The id of the input element.

props.name: class
props.description:
CSS class applied to the element, or a function that
returns a class based on the component's state.

props.name: style
props.description:
Style applied to the element, or a function that
returns a style object based on the component's state.

props.name: render
props.description: Replace the default element with a tag name, component, or render function.

dataAttributes.name: data-checked
dataAttributes.description: Present when the checkbox is checked.

dataAttributes.name: data-unchecked
dataAttributes.description: Present when the checkbox is not checked.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the checkbox is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-readonly
dataAttributes.description: Present when the checkbox is readonly.

dataAttributes.name: data-required
dataAttributes.description: Present when the checkbox is required.

dataAttributes.name: data-valid
dataAttributes.description: Present when the checkbox is in a valid state (when wrapped in Field.Root).

dataAttributes.name: data-invalid
dataAttributes.description: Present when the checkbox is in an invalid state (when wrapped in Field.Root).

dataAttributes.name: data-dirty
dataAttributes.description: Present when the checkbox's value has changed (when wrapped in Field.Root).

dataAttributes.name: data-touched
dataAttributes.description: Present when the checkbox has been touched (when wrapped in Field.Root).

dataAttributes.name: data-filled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the checkbox is checked (when wrapped in Field.Root).

dataAttributes.name: data-focused
dataAttributes.description: Present when the checkbox is focused (when wrapped in Field.Root).

dataAttributes.name: data-indeterminate
dataAttributes.description: Present when the checkbox is in an indeterminate state.

additionalTypes.name: Root.State
Root.ChangeEventDetails
